title: ID0425108-DC/Si-D/IT-[ MP / R9 170002654 ]Meter_BC5_AC_Charging
description:
Reported issue: On 16 May at 12:10, 12:13 a.m., 12:25 a.m. and 12:37 a.m. a customer tried to charge on this charger. (ID Charges: 5451076 - 5451077 - 5451080 - 5451081 ). He paid with Pos, and every time the charge started, it was interrupted. On Mindcharge the reason seems to be "passage of Rfid Card", but it is not. Every time he had the problem with plug 3 of the Charger.

Thank you.

Dear Filomena Carusone,
As checked in logs from 22:00 to 23:00 of 15/05/25 UTC. as 22:00 to 23UTC =12:00 to 01:00 of 16/05/2025 IT Local time
As per the log analysis it is observed that multiple times Charging session was tried in AC1 & charging session was failed due to communication lost between AC Meter-Switch- PLC (AC1 Errorcode:5)
Time of Charging session attempts:
2025-05-15T22:10:56.668647
2025-05-15T22:13:27.994874
2025-05-15T22:25:17.049113+00:00

We will be informing the region to check the charger as soon as possible along with required spare materials.
Region will communicate with you when ever site visit will be planned.
With best regards,
